plain: Never letting up; showing no mercy

webster.text: Unmoved by pity; unpitying; insensible to the distresses of others; destitute of tenderness; as a prey to relentless despotism.

example.quote: Parents are taken, and children left ; or possibly they may be so fortunate as to have a whole family taken and carried off together by these relentless robbers.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New Hampshire Convention, Hon. JOSHUA ATHERTON, 1788 (undated fragment printed by Elliot) (2d ed. 1836)
